description.value: Aidan's Coffee & Food is a specialty coffee café running two lobby-style locations in Vancouver — one in the W Hastings corridor and one on W Broadway — with a focused menu of espresso drinks, matcha lattes, pastries, and grab-and-go wraps and sandwiches. Online pre-ordering with curbside pickup is available, making it easy to collect a coffee and a bite without waiting in line. It's a practical urban refuel point for cyclists moving through the downtown core or the Broadway corridor.

address.value: 1055 W Hastings St, lobby, Vancouver, BC V6E 2E9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website successfully fetched and confirms an active business with two Vancouver locations and a live online ordering system; OSM coordinates (49.2876599, -123.118113) place the node in downtown Vancouver near W Hastings, consistent with the 1055 W Hastings St lobby address. Takeout is confirmed by the online pickup ordering flow; the Chickpea Guacamole Wrap confirms at least one vegetarian option. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, wi-fi, or charging information appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record carries no street address; the business operates two Vancouver locations (1055 W Hastings St lobby, V6E 2E9 and 805 W Broadway #111, V5Z 1H2). This node is mapped to the W Hastings address based on coordinates but is not confirmed by OSM tags.
Phone number (604) 318-2794 sourced from website only — OSM has no phone field to cross-check.
Two different contact emails listed per location: aidanscafe@gmail.com (W Hastings) and aidanscafe@icloud.com (W Broadway).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active café with a live website and online ordering confirmed; a useful refreshment stop for touring cyclists in Vancouver.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Chickpea Guacamole Wrap (vegetarian); no explicit vegan or GF labelling observed
